name: Memory bandwidth (bw_mem)
description: bw_mem allocates twice the specified amount of memory, zeros it, and then times the copying of the first half to the second half. Results are reported in megabytes moved per second (MB/sec). bw_mem is provided by lmbench. For more details, see the man pages.

config_fields.size: Amount of memory to be used in MB
config_fields.operation: The type of measurement: 'rd' measures the time to read data into the processor, 'wr' measures the time to write data to memory, and 'rdwr' measures the time to read data into memory and then write data to the same memory location.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.duration: Duration (seconds) of the benchmarking framework run that produced this score, shared by all benchmarks and configs of that run.
